verdict.rationale: The API documents a per-request opt-out: setting enable_logging=false switches the request to zero retention mode, so request data is not logged or retained. This is the product's own privacy opt-out, but it covers request logging and retention, not explicitly telemetry or usage analytics, and it applies per request rather than as an account-wide setting. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out, an account-level privacy setting, documentation of what tracking remains with logging off, and independent corroboration.
